<!--

         https://github.com/Unitech/pm2/search?type=Issues

    If not please fill out the following questions:
-->

**What's going wrong?**

I'm trying to use pm2 as a daemonizer for node scripts. See [1](https://github.com/Unitech/pm2/issues/2880), [2](https://github.com/Unitech/pm2/issues/2905). After some research I decided to use as less API functions as I can.  In [the project I do](https://github.com/finom/mongo-git-backup) I use `pm2.start` very similar way of how it's described in the documentation.

```js
pm2.start({
                script: `${__dirname}/daemon.js`,
                name: 'mongo-git-backup',
                error_file: `${__dirname}/err.log`,
                out_file: `${__dirname}/out.log`
            }, (err) => { // eslint-disable-line no-shadow
                pm2.disconnect();

                if (err) {
                    console.log(chalk.red(err));
                    reject(err);
                } else {
                    console.log(chalk.green('Done!'));
                    resolve();
                }
            });
```
It works great locally but I get error when I try to reuse this tool at remote server. I get:

```
/usr/lib/node_modules/mongo-git-backup/node_modules/pm2/lib/API.js:1031
        Common.printOut(conf.PREFIX_MSG + 'App [%s] launched (%d instances)', data[0].pm2_env.name, data.length);
                                                                                     ^

TypeError: Cannot read property 'pm2_env' of undefined
    at /usr/lib/node_modules/mongo-git-backup/node_modules/pm2/lib/API.js:1031:86
    at /usr/lib/node_modules/mongo-git-backup/node_modules/pm2-axon-rpc/lib/client.js:45:10
    at Parser.<anonymous> (/usr/lib/node_modules/mongo-git-backup/node_modules/pm2-axon/lib/sockets/req.js:67:8)
    at emitOne (events.js:96:13)
    at Parser.emit (events.js:191:7)
    at Parser._write (/usr/lib/node_modules/mongo-git-backup/node_modules/amp/lib/stream.js:91:16)
    at doWrite (_stream_writable.js:329:12)
    at writeOrBuffer (_stream_writable.js:315:5)
    at Parser.Writable.write (_stream_writable.js:241:11)
    at Socket.ondata (_stream_readable.js:557:20)

```



**How could we reproduce this issue?**
Have no idea how to localize the issue. [The tool can be installed and run](https://github.com/finom/mongo-git-backup)  as described at the documentation.

```
mongo-git-backup export --db=DB --repo=REPO --daemonize
```

## Supporting information

```
PM2 version: `2.4.6`
Node version: `7.10`
Ubuntu 16
```

body: @tnguyen14 I think it may have to do with if the log file specified is accessible/writeable. That's what appeared to have solve the issue for me.

confirmed, it has been fixed. you can try the fix:

```
$ npm install Unitech/pm2#development -g
$ pm2 update
```
